messages:
Jane Acme: Hey, partner voucher PARTNER2026 showed as accepted in the UI and I got the confirmation email, but org balance is still 0. Org ID: org-3482. Can someone check?
Sam Support: Sorry about that—can you paste the confirmation email or the redemption ID? Did you redeem via the partner SSO flow or manually? :thinking_face:
Jane Acme: Redeemed via SSO (partner SAML). Email has 'Grant applied to account' and a redemption id: rdm-20260315-88. Screenshot attached to ticket #5472.
Sam Support: thanks — escalating to billing + infra. @Darren Billing @Priya Eng please take a look.
Darren Billing: on it. Can you paste the org billing account id shown in your org settings? Also any invoice/ledger id from the email?
Jane Acme: billing account in settings is acct-acme-77. Email shows ledger_ref: ledger-98321 but the body is pretty generic.
ledger-bot: webhook received: {"redemption_id":"rdm-20260315-88","partner":"acme-partner","amount":5000,"currency":"USD","target_account":"acct-acme-77","status":"ACK"} :white_check_mark:
ingest-bot: ingestion event queued id=evt-9132 for redemption rdm-20260315-88 -> scheduled worker 03:12 UTC
Priya Eng: quick debug dump from our mapping service (scrubbed):
```
[03:12:04] received evt-9132 payload {redemption_id: "rdm-20260315-88", partner_id: "acme-partner", target_account: "acct-acme-77"}
[03:12:04] lookup tenant by partner_id -> found legacy_tenant_42
[03:12:04] map target_account acct-acme-77 -> billing_account legacy-billing-42
[03:12:04] writing grant to ledger under billing_account legacy-billing-42 as txn-20260315-774
[03:12:05] respond ACK to partner
```
Priya Eng: the problem looks like the partner->tenant mapping points at a legacy tenant (legacy_tenant_42) which is NOT tied to org-3482. Ledger entry was written, but to legacy-billing-42, so org-3482 balance won't reflect it.
Darren Billing: confirmed ledger txn txn-20260315-774 exists and is for 5000 units to legacy-billing-42. That's why customer sees 0.
Sam Support: ok — plan: 1) manual reassign ledger txn txn-20260315-774 from legacy-billing-42 to acct-acme-77 (manual credit) 2) fix mapping rule for acme-partner -> org-3482 so future grants land in correct account 3) follow up w/partner that SSO metadata changed.
Priya Eng: I can patch the mapping rules; will also add a validation check to flag partner mappings that point to legacy tenants. PR drafted, deploying now.
Darren Billing: I'm performing the manual reassign now. Will post txn id when complete.
Darren Billing: done — ledger txn txn-20260315-774 reassigned to acct-acme-77 and balance updated. Please refresh and confirm.
Jane Acme: refreshed — balance shows +5000, thank you!! :tada: Any ETA on the mapping fix so this doesn't recur?
Priya Eng: mapping patch deployed to staging, rollout to prod in ~2 hours after smoke tests. I'll post the PR link and the partner ticket.
Sam Support: PR and partner outreach: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1291 assigned to @Priya Eng. Setting priority P1 for partner grants since this can leave customers uncredited.
Jane Acme: appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep me in the loop on partner ticket.
Sam Support: will do. Closing this thread after partner confirms metadata. If anything else shows up tag @Sam Support. :raised_hands:
